hero_intro: A service-disabled veteran-owned MEP and technology engineering firm in Lafayette and Houston, designing the systems inside the buildings our communities depend on since 1997.
services_heading: Every system a building depends on.
services_intro: Mechanical, electrical, plumbing, fire protection and the technology systems that tie a facility together, so architects and owners coordinate with one firm from kickoff to closeout.

services.name: HVAC
services.text: New systems, equipment assessments and temporary cooling during transitions.

services.name: Plumbing
services.text: Domestic water, sanitary, storm, and water and wastewater systems.

services.name: Fire Protection
services.text: Sprinkler systems coordinated with the building's life-safety design.

services.name: Power & Emergency Power
services.text: Service, distribution, generators and standby power.

services.name: Lighting
services.text: Interior, exterior and sports lighting, with controls.

services.name: Fire Alarm
services.text: Addressable fire alarm and emergency voice/alarm communication.

services.name: Security
services.text: Surveillance, intrusion detection and access control.

services.name: Structured Cabling
services.text: Voice, data, intercom, paging and low-voltage infrastructure.

services.name: Water / Wastewater
services.text: Systems for municipal and facility clients.

process.text: Understand the owner's goals, the existing conditions and the code requirements before design starts.
Coordinate every MEP and technology system with the architect into clear, biddable construction documents.
Stay with the project through bidding and construction: submittals, RFIs and site observations to closeout.

culture_text: Be humbly confident. Build open and honest relationships. Respond timely and timely delivery. Be intelligently inquisitive. Our core focus: providing comfort and protection to mankind.
